mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the capillary sprout to the wound was most worthwhile: it showed that a new branch has to connect to another vessel before blood can flow through it.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the supporting fibres and new skin cells felt a little repetitive, although the pictures made clear that both still had to be fitted into the wound.

surprise.text: I was surprised that closing the skin surface did not mean the deeper tissue had finished repairing.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The pictures and named slots gave each combination a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing the separate parts of repair come together was satisfying, and I would be curious to see another process built this way.
